checks: Original Reset clears original_callback_ before req_.data. Proposed Entry.reset clears the same borrowed callback descriptor before dispatched=false, preserving counted precondition.

Original Dispatch calls Dispatched before MakeLibuvRequestCallback::For; For checks the null field and stores the original callback before the actual libuv call. Both proposed read routes preserve this order.

Only a nonnegative actual native result calls dispatchAccepted, which retains the existing original ClearWeak then waiting-counter order. Raw dispatch returns the real c_int result and does not synthesize a completion for negative admission.

Original Wrapper takes BaseObjectPtr, Detach, DecreaseWaitingRequestCounter, then reads/calls original_callback_. Proposed delivery calls the unchanged beginCallback before copying the callback descriptor, invokes it once, and releases the retained native pointer only after its actual callback and failure recording.

A callback may Reset/resubmit the same Entry. Delivery uses the locally selected descriptor; after invocation it does not reread old callback fields or result metadata. EndCallback retires only the outer native pointer entitlement.
The one Environment queue remains authoritative. Borrowed native address/function records add no retained JS wrapper, allocation, map, request, service or event owner.
limits: Review is the requested Source/order slice of a proposal. Root owns shared native CHECK dispatch, and VM owns embedded-event concurrency and native protocol qualification.
Actual FileHandle/ReadWrap construction, backing retention through EmitRead, callback implementation and runtime remain separate dependencies.
The simplified CHECK function diagnostic label is not compiler __PRETTY_FUNCTION__/__FUNCSIG__ byte equivalence.
